owner_and_capability: People Directory — the birthday display (#1542) leaves services/users as a native capability (internal domain, ports and application, public contract peopledirectory.Birthdays, composition in modules/peopledirectory/compose) and its HTTP adapter becomes modules/peopledirectory/inbound/birthdays; slice 2 of #2728 (#3751). The feedback counter, RFID card and student-photo settings side-effect files of services/users are dropped or moved to their consumers, and the parent request reason rule moves to Settings Platform's retained package (services/config).
atomic_cutover: One code-only change. birthday_service.go leaves services/users: the celebration window, leap-day, visibility and sorting rules are People Directory domain code, the person, student and staff reads and the two display settings are ports bound by services/birthday_composition.go over the retained repositories and the tenant settings, and the routes move from modules/birthdays/http to modules/peopledirectory/inbound/birthdays (owner people-directory, role http); the inbound-birthdays owner and its rules are removed from policy.json. feedback_counter.go is dropped for the consumer-owned workflows/studentdeletion/compose.Feedback port, rfid_cards.go is declared beside its only consumer, RegisterStudentPhotoSettingsSideEffects moves to the root composition behind a one-method port, and ReasonRequiredFor moves to services/config while the shared ErrParentRequestReasonRequired sentinel is retired in favour of the Care Plan sentinel the only matching renderer already maps to the same reason_required code.
